page.overview:
Who is Darmani III?

In life, Darmani III was a renowned Goron hero. He was considered the greatest warrior of his tribe and possible heir to the throne. He suffered a terrible accident when he ventured to Snowhead Temple to find and stop the culprit that was causing the devastating winter that threatened his people. On his way to the , was knocked off the path and into the deep valley below by the blizzard caused by Biggoron and unfortunately lost his life.

In his death, Darmani was doomed to haunt his somber grave in the Goron Graveyard. He became full of regrets and felt sorrow for failing his people. Although he cannot normally be seen with the naked eye as he is now a spirit, Link can find Darmani with the Lens of Truth at the Goron Village, where he will tell the young Hero of Time to follow him to the Goron Graveyard (where he becomes fully visible) before explaining why he died. Link then must heal his spirit by playing the "Song of Healing" to free him from his regrets. Upon doing so, Darmani III sees visions of when he was a famous hero and the Gorons cheering him on, alongside Link himself. Before passing on, decides to leave his own powers in the Goron Mask for the fellow Hylian hero, which allows Link to transform into Goron Link when worn.

When spring returns to upon the defeat of , the Goron Elder announces to Link his plans to step down as patriarch of the tribe and hand the position over to , whom he mistakes Goron Link for due to his resemblance.
